dynamic_feed.cache_policy: fetch latest_url with cache disabled or append a timestamp/cache-buster; then follow the absolute URLs it returns

frontend_contract: Load tunnel_contract_url once as the consumer protocol; it defines bootstrap, routing, cache and status-handshake behavior.
On every page load, fetch dynamic_feed.latest_url first rather than resolving latest.json against the chatgpt.site origin.
Then fetch latest.story_index_url. Do not guess a relative backend base path.
Use each story's route, text_url, text_state, text_source_kind, text_completeness, facsimile_route, and reading_order_basis.
When text_url is present, title and byline link to /stories/<slug>/.
The story route fetches text_url and renders display_text as provisional machine text, with facsimile_route beside it.
Prefer page-aware column OCR reordered by printed page number over legacy layout-text OCR whenever both exist.
If text_completeness says the recovered printed-page range is partial, show a compact warning rather than implying a complete transcription.
Do not hide a story because text is provisional; label the text state compactly.
If backend fetch fails, keep the packaged site snapshot and report fallback state on /reconstruction-status/.

On /reconstruction-status/, show bundle_version, latest.built_utc, story counts, page-parser counts, complete-range counts, live-vs-fallback state, frontend fetch time, and the actual backend URL fetched.
A successful backend fetch should never leave a text-ready story as an unlinked contents item.

current_backend_expectation.geometry_model: one PDF page is one photographed printed magazine page; many pages contain two text columns; source PDF page order may differ from printed reading order
current_backend_expectation.note: the active parser reconstructs column reading order inside each page, then sorts pages by recovered printed page number and applies story starts from the source-reviewed contents tables

style.case_rule: Strict lowercase for the publication lockup and ordinary site chrome unless reproducing source typography.
style.render_note: Render the complete lockup in lowercase italics, preferably Times/Times New Roman. Do not convert it to title case or all caps.
